name: Zoo Crew Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about animals, nature and the earth on Zoo grounds. Teens manage their own schedules.
pay_detail: Unpaid. No fee listed on the page.
duration: About 4 hours a month for a year, plus a required 4-day training. After one year you must be invited back.
deadline_text: Zoo says it will reopen Zoo Crew in January 2027 for the Spring 2027 class. Training is in late May and all days are required.
how_to_apply: Use the zoo volunteer application when it reopens in January 2027, with the teen's own email and phone number. The page gives no direct Zoo Crew link. Call (520) 791-3204 with questions.
notes: Applications are closed now. Teens should be their own main contact with the zoo.
